player_context.note: Feels solid but I get impatient in longer rallies.

knee_flexion_deg_at_contact.note: smaller = deeper bend; measured at ball contact

paddle_face_angle_deg_at_contact.note: degrees open from vertical; open face lofts the ball

contact_point_vs_lead_foot_cm.note: positive = contact in front of lead foot (good)

backswing_length_cm.note: paddle travel behind hip; longer adds pace

weight_transfer_score.note: back-to-front weight shift into the shot

split_step_timing_ms.note: ms relative to opponent contact; negative = late

recovery_to_kitchen_score.note: how consistently player advances toward the kitchen after the drop

shot_outcome.note: where the drop landed across the 8 reps; kitchen = ideal
